description: This file defines the LanguageManager class in Drupal, responsible for providing language support on language-unaware sites, including methods for retrieving and managing language information and lists.

classes.name: LanguageManager
classes.description: Provides language support, manages language lists, and handles language-related operations for Drupal sites.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LanguageManager with a default language object.

methods.name: isMultilingual
methods.description: Indicates whether the site supports multiple languages (returns FALSE).

methods.name: getLanguageTypes
methods.description: Returns the list of language types supported: interface, content, and URL.

methods.name: getDefinedLanguageTypesInfo
methods.description: Provides information about all defined language types, including name, description, and lock status.

methods.name: getCurrentLanguage
methods.description: Returns the current default language.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the language manager state (no operation).

methods.name: getDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the default language object.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Returns a list of languages based on specified flags, utilizing caching.

methods.name: getNativeLanguages
methods.description: Returns languages in a language-unaware site, same as getLanguages.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Fetches a language by its language code.

methods.name: getLanguageName
methods.description: Returns the name of a language given its code, handling special cases.

methods.name: getDefaultLockedLanguages
methods.description: Provides a list of default locked languages with specific properties.

methods.name: isLanguageLocked
methods.description: Checks if a language is locked.

methods.name: getFallbackCandidates
methods.description: Returns fallback language codes.

methods.name: getLanguageSwitchLinks
methods.description: Returns language switch links for a given URL and type (returns NULL).

methods.name: getStandardLanguageList
methods.description: Provides a list of standard languages supported, based on localize.drupal.org.

methods.name: getUnitedNationsLanguageList
methods.description: Provides a list of the six official UN languages.

methods.name: setConfigOverrideLanguage
methods.description: Sets a configuration override language (noop).

methods.name: getConfigOverrideLanguage
methods.description: Returns the current language as the override.

methods.name: filterLanguages
methods.description: Filters a list of languages based on flags, including site default, locked, and configurable.
